window: Tuesday, 3:30 am to 4:15 am. Start here
goal: Know the shape of the paper and the procedures before meeting any content. The scope note matters: this paper is generated from the manual, so graphs, trees and Boolean algebra are not on it.
drill: Nothing yet. Read the nine recipes once. You will come back to them at the end.

goal: Logic, which is the whole of test 1. Fifteen of the forty-five questions the examiner has already set, written by the same generator that is writing your paper.
drill: All 15 test 1 questions sit inside these lessons. AND needs both, OR needs one, IMPLIES fails only on true-then-false, IF AND ONLY IF needs agreement.

goal: Sets and functions. Functions alone are thirteen of test 2 questions, and four turn on one sentence: domain in, codomain allowed out, range actually out.
drill: Say the domain sentence without pausing, and check every power set against 2 to the n. This is the largest single block on the paper.

goal: Proof, induction, sequences and recurrence: another sixteen of test 2 questions. Vocabulary plus one method each, so they read fast.
drill: Lemma before, corollary after, theorem proved, conjecture not yet. Base case then step, four headings. Subtract for arithmetic, divide for geometric.

goal: The counting modules. Neither test touched them, but the manual carries them, and the manual is what your paper is generated from, so they are live.
drill: One question decides every counting problem: does order matter. Yes is a permutation, no is a combination.

window: Tuesday, 9:15 am to 9:40 am, then leave for the hall
goal: The cram sheet, then the recipes again. Finish on procedures rather than on new material.
drill: Re-read the nine recipes in the last ten minutes. Name the question, find the recipe, follow the steps.

window: Only if you somehow have time to spare
goal: The two solved past papers. They are NO LONGER the target, since this paper is generated from the course manual rather than from previous papers, and they ask about graphs, trees and Boolean algebra the manual does not cover.
drill: Skip anything on graphs, trees, Boolean algebra, posets or lattices. None of it is in the manual.
